#!/bin/zsh
#FLUX --account=VeloC
#FLUX --nodes=8
#FLUX --time=2:00:00
#FLUX --queue=full-node
#FLUX --constraint=filesystems=home
#FLUX --mail-user=thomas.bouvier@inria.fr

# The following cobalt option is the default submission mode for flux and has been omitted:
# #COBALT --mode script

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
# The '-map-by slot' option from mpiexec does not have a direct equivalent in 'flux run'.
# Flux's default task distribution is generally efficient and may provide similar performance.
# The '-hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE' option is not needed as flux run automatically uses allocated nodes.
# Environment variables specified with '-x' in mpiexec are exported to the environment before the run command.
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
flux run -n 64 --tasks-per-node=8 --cpu-affinity=off python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_scratch_ghostnet_scale --log-level info

issues: The LD_LIBRARY_PATH variable uses semicolons (;) as separators. On Linux systems, the correct separator is a colon (:). This will likely cause shared libraries to not be found.

The command to be executed uses a relative path ('../../main.py'), which can be fragile. It depends on the job being submitted from a specific working directory. Using an absolute path or ensuring the script changes to the correct directory first is more robust.

#!/bin/zsh
#COBALT -A VeloC
#COBALT -n 8
#COBALT -t 2:00:00
#COBALT --mode script
#COBALT -q full-node
#COBALT --attr filesystems=home
#COBALT -M thomas.bouvier@inria.fr

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
mpiexec -np 64 -npernode 8 -hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE -bind-to none -map-by slot -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x WANDB_MODE -x PATH python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_scratch_ghostnet_scale --log-level info
